description: Bronze: the assets API as it came, one partition per day. Silver: one row per host, merged.
sql: CREATE VIEW bronze AS SELECT *, '{{ run_date }}' AS load_date FROM assets
CREATE VIEW silver AS SELECT hostname, ip, os, risk, CAST(last_seen AS TIMESTAMP) AS last_seen FROM bronze QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY hostname ORDER BY last_seen DESC) = 1
